mapper.select: select * from ( select 'WEBHOOK'::text as source,id,terminal_event_key,event_type,delivery_status,attempt, next_retry_at,delivery_claim_until as claim_until,response_body as error_message,created_at from batch.webhook_delivery_log where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and terminal_event_key is not null union all select 'RULE'::text as source,id,terminal_event_key,event_type,delivery_status,attempt, next_retry_at,delivery_claim_until as claim_until,error_message,created_at from batch.notification_delivery_log where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and terminal_event_key is not null ) deliveries order by created_at desc,id desc,source limit #{limit}

select #{source}::text as source,id,terminal_event_key,event_type,delivery_status,attempt, next_retry_at,delivery_claim_until as claim_until, as error_message,created_at from where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and id=#{id} and terminal_event_key is not null for update
mapper.update: update set attempt=0,delivery_status='PENDING',next_retry_at=current_timestamp, delivery_claim_token=null,delivery_claim_until=null where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and id=#{id} and terminal_event_key is not null and delivery_status='EXHAUSTED' and next_retry_at is null and (delivery_claim_until is null or delivery_claim_until <= current_timestamp)
